safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes the rash on chest/hands/inside elbows but does not mention back as a main location, so the full gold concept of 'mainly chest and back' is not captured.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the back as a main rash location slightly degrades localization and pattern recognition, which can influence the differential (e.g., distribution suggestive of contact dermatitis vs eczema). In this case, management is still likely similar, so the impact is mainly documentation/diagnostic clarity.
